subject: HR vendor consolidation: Greenhouse renewal & background checks
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: Action: Greenhouse renewal (Jan '27) + background check vendor strategy

Team —

Quick summary: our current Greenhouse contract expires 2027-01-31. We also have a mix of background-check vendors across orgs (Clear Backgrounds for EMEA hiring pilots and Checkr for the US). Given growth and our need to standardize the hiring stack (and reduce per-hire ops), I recommend we run a consolidated procurement: renew Greenhouse with a pricing/feature review and pursue a single background-check vendor for US/EMEA.

Key asks:
- Approval to engage Greenhouse on a 2-year renewal and to negotiate credits tied to adoption milestones.
- Approval to run a 6-week pilot with Checkr for EU+US roles (evaluate turnaround, data residency notes, and EDD/ADR coverage).
- Permission to include PeopleFirst Consulting for a short SOW to help with migration runbook (up to $15k).

Attached: Consolidation_RFP_Responses.zip with initial vendor notes.

Timeline constraints: procurement needs a signed LOI by 2026-12-15 to hit implementation in Q1.

Can I get a thumbs-up or objections by EOD Friday (11/26)?

Thanks —
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@greenhouse.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T14:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Action: Greenhouse renewal (Jan '27) + background check vendor strategy

Hi Neha / Vivek —

Thanks for the heads-up. I've attached a tailored proposal for Redwood that reflects a 2-year commitment: Greenhouse_proposal_Q1-2027.pdf (attached). Highlights:
- 15% list discount on core seats for 2-year term; additional $25k implementation credit if we sign before 2026-12-20.
- Included: Advanced onboarding sessions for Recruiting (2 workshops) + SSO + Audit log export for Private deployments.
- We can provide a 30-day pilot environment for new features (scorecards, offer workflows) at no extra charge.

Open items from our side: a) confirmation of anticipated monthly active users (for seat tiering) and b) whether the background-check integration will be a single-vendor webhook or via ATS-native connectors.

If useful, I can jump on a 30-min call next week to walk through the proposal.

— Priya Shah
Enterprise Account Executive, Greenhouse
priya.shah@greenhouse.io

Date: 2026-11-25T10:37:00Z
Subject: Checkr pricing + pilot plan for Redwood (reply to Greenhouse thread)

Hey Neha/Laura —

Appreciate the inclusion. Per our conversation last month, attaching a pricing worksheet and a proposed 6-week pilot plan: Checkr_pricing_worksheet.xlsx (attached). TL;DR:
- Pilot for US+EU jobs (up to 500 checks) — free for pilot period.
- Volume-based pricing starts at $6.50/check with rebate tiers for >10k annual checks.
- Estimated integration time (ATS connector + mapping) — 2 weeks if greenfield, 4 weeks if custom mappings required.

We can provide an SOC2 report and EU data residency options; will coordinate with your security team. If you want, we can run a pilot kickoff on 12/07.

Best,
Tom Ellis
Strategic Accounts — Checkr

I ran this by the recruiting leads — we're aligned to standardize on one background-check vendor if (a) the turnaround stays <48 hours for US and <72 hours for EU after pilot, (b) pricing is within the Checkr worksheet bands, and (c) the vendor supports the Greenhouse connector.

I support starting the Checkr pilot on 12/07. For Greenhouse, we should accept their 2-year term only if we get the $25k implementation credit and a clause that limits price increases to CPI + 2% year-over-year.

Laura

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T11:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Action: Greenhouse renewal (Jan '27) + background check vendor strategy

Neha / team —

Budget note from Finance: we have ~$280k allocated for Recruiting tools in FY27 (OPEX). Greenhouse renewal at list plus a modest discount will consume ~60-70% of that if we take a 2-year commitment upfront. Before committing, procurement should negotiate:
- $25k implementation credit (as Priya offered) to be applied in year 1.
- A cap on annual price increase (agree with Laura: CPI + 2%).
- Ensure billing can be staged as 12x monthly to keep OPEX flat rather than a large prepaid CAPEX hit.

If Checkr's pilot delivers on turnaround and pricing, we can reallocate savings from onboarding to cover the PeopleFirst SOW.

Markus
VP, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@greenhouse.io>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@checkr.com>, Alyssa Barnes <alyssa@peoplefirst.co>
Date: 2026-12-05T16:02:00Z
Subject: Final: proceed with pilot + conditional Greenhouse renewal

Thanks for the rapid feedback — clear consensus. Decision & next steps: 

1) Greenhouse: approve moving forward with the 2-year renewal provided Greenhouse confirms in writing the $25k implementation credit, CPI+2% cap on increases, and monthly invoicing option. Priya — please update the proposal and send a DLPS/LOI for legal review by 2026-12-12.

2) Background checks: approve Checkr 6-week pilot starting 2026-12-07. Tom — please confirm kickoff date and provide SOC2 + data residency addendum to the security mailbox. Laura — run pilot hiring clusters (eng + product) and report on TAT and false positive rates.

3) PeopleFirst SOW: approved up to $15k for a migration runbook. Alyssa — please send a short SOW and estimated delivery milestones; procurement will convert to PO once Checkr pilot shows go/no-go.

4) Finance constraints noted: Markus, procurement will seek staged monthly billing to keep spend OPEX-friendly.

If all parties accept these conditions, procurement/legal to prepare contract paperwork and target signed agreements by 2026-12-22.

I'll escalate any blockers after 12/12. Thanks — moving fast here is important for our Q1 hiring plan.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Platforms & Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
